description: EP-Online is the official national database of energy labels and energy performance indicators of buildings in the Netherlands, where valid labels can be consulted as public information. Searches work by registration number, postcode and house number, BAG building or address identifiers (pand, verblijfsobject, ligplaats or standplaats ID) or project name, and large numbers of valid labels can be obtained from bulk files (totaalbestanden) or a web service. A definitive registered energy label has been compulsory at sale, rental and delivery of buildings since 1 January 2008; private owners download label copies via MijnOverheid and business owners via EP-Online with eHerkenning, for homes from 2015 and utility buildings from 2021. Coverage: labelled buildings in the Netherlands. Access: free search, bulk files and web service. Licence: public government information. Caveats: only buildings that have been labelled appear, and label methods have changed over time. Simulation uses are building-level energy performance and characteristics, linked by BAG IDs, for stock models and retrofit targeting. Related records: the England and Wales EPC register, the SEAI BER research tool and the French DPE data.
